baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْأَوَّلُ/ٱلْءَاخِرُ (words 2-3), completed by بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ (words 7-9).
baseline_models.mechanism: Opposed ordinal limits bracket any sequence; total enclosure and disclosure to the knower make the bracket exhaustive rather than merely chronological.

activation_trace.role: Beginning and precedence supply the opening limit of every sequence.
Lastness after the first supplies the opposed terminal limit.
Total enclosure extends the paired limits across every item.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower makes the enclosure epistemically complete.

changed_reading.before: Two titles mark extreme temporal positions.
changed_reading.after: The pair reads as exhaustive divine inclusion of every sequence from its first term through its last, with no member outside knowledge.

baseline_models.mechanism: The pair joins exposure/concealment to the concrete back/belly opposition. Predication of both to one subject preserves the contrast while denying an inaccessible interior.

activation_trace.role: Emergence and exposure supply the perceptible face of the pair.
Back as the side opposed to belly makes the polarity concretely exterior/interior.
The concealed inward reality supplies the epistemically hidden side.
Disclosure to the knower prevents inwardness from becoming a blind region.

changed_reading.before: The Manifest is visible while the Hidden is invisible.
changed_reading.after: The same subject holds exposed surface and concealed interior together; hiddenness marks creaturely access, not a limit on divine knowing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving life and causing death operationalize First/Last as entry and termination of living force; the return of all affairs bends the line into a source-to-return arc under one sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Beginning and precedence anchor the source end of the arc.
Lastness anchors the terminal end of the arc.
Earth revived through rain and growth gives يُحْيِۦ a concrete regenerative beginning-image.
Causing force and life to depart gives يُمِيتُ an enacted terminal image.
Return to what was turns the terminal limit toward a destination and source.

structural_cues: 57:2 juxtaposes enlivening and causing death under dominion; 57:5 says affairs are returned to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enlivening, death, and return; I align those motions with First as source and Last as destination. A live alternative keeps the names as transcendent limits rather than stages of a cycle.

changed_reading.before: First and Last statically bound a timeline.
changed_reading.after: First and Last also govern a dynamic arc in which life emerges, ends, and every affair returns to its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Entry/exit and descent/ascent repeatedly cross terrestrial, celestial, light/dark, and inward boundaries. Manifest/Hidden therefore become mastery of circulation across surfaces, not a sealed static duality.

activation_trace.role: Exposure anchors the outward state reached by crossing.
The inside of a thing anchors the inward state being entered or left.
Entry into another thing's interior turns hiddenness into a crossed boundary.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the reverse motion into manifestation.
Descent adds a downward crossing to the inside/outside exchange.
Ascent supplies the mirrored upward crossing.
Repeated reciprocal insertion of night and day makes boundary exchange continuous.
The breast as origin from which acts issue places knowledge inside a causal source.

structural_cues: 57:4 pairs what enters/exits earth and descends/ascends sky; 57:6 twice inserts night and day into one another before invoking knowledge of breasts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored motions, reciprocal insertion, and inward knowledge; I infer a permeable boundary system connecting them. A live alternative reads them as an inventory of separate motions under knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Manifest and Hidden name fixed outer and inner zones.
changed_reading.after: They name exhaustive presence across a permeable world whose contents cross surfaces in both directions while concealed sources remain known.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening divides otherwise similar acts: expenditure and combat before visible victory receive a greater degree than afterward. First/Last becomes an ethically weighted ordering by position relative to disclosure and risk.

activation_trace.role: Precedence anchors the morally weightier early position.
After-first lastness anchors the later position without erasing its promised good.
Temporal precedence marks action undertaken before the outcome is secured.
The opening of victory is the disclosure threshold separating the cohorts.
Degree-by-degree ordering converts chronology into differentiated rank.
Afterness supplies the later, lower-risk side of the threshold.

structural_cues: 57:10 repeats the same two acts before and after the opening, denies equal rank, yet promises good to both cohorts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies before/after, unequal degree, and shared good; I map that temporal valuation back to the paired names. A live alternative confines the ranking to human cohorts and leaves the divine names ontological.

changed_reading.before: First and Last exhaust time without valuing positions within it.
changed_reading.after: The pair can expose how the same act changes moral weight when performed before rather than after decisive manifestation.

context_deltas.mechanism: One enclosing wall has a gate, an interior of mercy, and an exterior facing punishment. Manifest/Hidden become relational positions on one boundary, with access and orientation determining the experienced side.

activation_trace.role: Exposure supplies the focus pair's outward face.
The inside of a thing supplies the focus pair's inward face.
A high enclosing wall gives the opposition one shared material boundary.
The entrance makes access, not mere visibility, part of the inside/outside mechanism.
The wall's interior concretely locates the side containing mercy.
The wall's exposed exterior concretely locates the side facing punishment.

structural_cues: 57:13 assigns mercy to باطنه and punishment from the direction of ظاهره after separation by a wall with a gate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one structure, two sides, and an access point; I infer that the pair is relational and topological rather than two substances. A live alternative treats the scene as an instance of moral separation without defining the names.

changed_reading.before: Manifest and Hidden are degrees of visibility.
changed_reading.after: They can be two experienced faces of one ordering: an inward side reached through access and an outward side exposed across the same boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Plant growth emerges, attracts admiration, dries and yellows, then becomes fragments. The Last is not merely after the manifest display; its terminal condition is carried as a trajectory within that display.

activation_trace.role: Beginning anchors emergence into the visible lifecycle.
Lastness anchors the terminal state toward which the display moves.
Visible emergence makes the middle display perceptually compelling.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the lifecycle's first visible state.
Drying and yellowing initiate reversal within the admired display.
Yellowing exposes decline on the plant's surface.
Vanishing worldly debris supplies the terminal state concealed by initial attraction.

structural_cues: 57:20 orders growth, admiration, drying, visible yellowing, and debris with repeated ثُمَّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered botanical sequence; I treat it as a concrete cross-section of First/Last and read terminal decay as latent in manifestation. A live alternative confines the simile to relativizing worldly life.

changed_reading.before: First, Last, and Manifest are separate abstract predicates.
changed_reading.after: They form a process grammar: what first appears already bears a hidden trajectory toward its last condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs, scale, justice, and iron externalize a public order, while aid rendered in the unseen locates an inward allegiance. Knowledge links the concealed commitment to its materially visible social effects.

activation_trace.role: Exposure anchors the public and materially inspectable side of the mechanism.
Concealed inward reality anchors allegiance not available to ordinary sight.
Meaning disclosed by statement or sign supplies explicit public evidence.
The scale of justice makes normative measure externally operable.
Justice and equity name the social effect sought through that measure.
Iron's resistant solidity gives the public order a material enforcement edge.
Disclosure to the knower connects inward allegiance with its test in action.
Aid that supports and makes prevail supplies the outward action of allegiance.
Concealment from eyes qualifies the allegiance as operative without direct sight.

structural_cues: 57:25 moves from clear signs, book, scale, justice, and iron to knowing who aids God and the messengers in the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible institutions and unseen aid; I infer a disclosure pipeline in which concealed allegiance produces public order. A live alternative lets بالغيب qualify aid without implying that inward commitment becomes socially legible.

changed_reading.before: Manifest and Hidden classify what can and cannot be seen.
changed_reading.after: They can organize a passage from unseen allegiance to publicly measured justice and materially consequential support, all already open to divine knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ء و ل→و ل ي mapping rather than the ordinary ordinal branch. It remains anchored to ٱلْأَوَّلُ and is sharpened by 'with you wherever you are' in 57:4; render it only as an exploratory resonance, never as a lexical replacement for First.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْأَوَّلُ at word 2 through the packet's split mapping to و ل ي, held beside the situated accompaniment of 57:4.

activation_trace.role: Nearness without a separator turns First from a remote start-point into immediate adjacency.
Uninterrupted succession carries that adjacency through each following state.
Occurrence and presence in time ground the phrase of accompaniment in every situated state.

changed_reading.before: The First is a remote point prior to the series.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, First also resonates as unseparated nearness through successive states: temporal before and after create no gap in accompaniment.

strongest_changes: The endpoint pair becomes a dynamic source-life-death-return arc rather than a static timeline.
Entry/exit and the wall's two sides recast Manifest/Hidden as permeable movement and differential access across one boundary.
Before/after the opening and the plant lifecycle give First/Last ethical and processual force inside time.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly materialized the focus ayah's abstract pairs as motions, thresholds, ranked timing, lifecycle, and an unseen-to-public evidence process; the packet's split mapping also preserved a form-distant nearness reading of First.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the contextual mechanisms define the divine names or only instantiate their reach remains open.
The ethical weighting of First/Last is anchored by 57:10 but less direct than the wall's exact recurrence of Manifest/Hidden.
The ء و ل→و ل ي nearness activation must remain exploratory because it is a non-dominant mapped root, not the ordinary lexical reading.
